# 0.1.5 — ATT&CK and MISP vocabulary ingest

13 September 2026. Patch on the public **0.1.4** beta.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.1.5
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Added

- Weekly (and `workflow_dispatch`) ingest for MITRE ATT&CK STIX and MISP threat actors. Vocabularies merge with RFC 0003 per-key versions; schema pins for techniques, actors, and datasources bump in the same PRs ([#174](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/pull/174)).

```bash
uv run python scripts/vocabulary/sync_upstream.py --check
uv run python scripts/vocabulary/sync_upstream.py --apply
```

## Fixed

- ATT&CK groups are catalog-only (`att&ck.groups`); live objects pin them via `threat.actors.name` → `actors::*`.
- Later weekly ingest cycles fetch `chore/vocab-upstream` before `git push --force-with-lease` so the specifications branch can update after the first cycle.

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide validate --strict
```

Expect `0.1.5`.
